name: Secure code review
description: Evidence-based security review of code or a diff in any language: injection, unsafe data handling, exposed secrets, risky configuration, prioritizing reachable attack surface. Use when asked to review code, a change or a repository for security.

references.description: What to look for, how to confirm and common false positives per vulnerability class.
Insecure defaults in config, deployment and container files.
API exposure, external integrations, dependencies and supply-chain risks.
